description: Type Discord's 404 on every operation that addresses an entity by a path parameter (a guild, channel, message, role, webhook, emoji, sticker, command, invite code, ...). Discord answers any unknown or inaccessible id with 404 and a 10xxx JSON code (10003 Unknown Channel, 10004 Unknown Guild, 10008 Unknown Message, 10011 Unknown Role, 10014 Unknown Emoji, 10015 Unknown Webhook, 10006 Unknown Invite, 10063 Unknown Application Command, ...; https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/opcodes-and-status-codes#json-json-error-codes), as 002 recorded live for GET /guilds/{guild_id} and GET /channels/{channel_id}. Alchemy's Discord resources catch it on read and delete (gone means gone). Only the 2 operations in 002 have a recorded live response; the others rest on Discord's documented 404 for an unknown resource. An operation whose 404 turns out to mean something else gets its own tag.
